item.title: Noah Kahan Concert Among Shows Canceled in New York Due to Inclement Weather on Saturday
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we catch you up on the latest music news. I'm your host, and today we're talking about two concerts that didn't go as planned in New York City. Let's dive in."
[Music transitions]
Host: "Noah Kahan's concert at Citi Field in Queens was canceled just before doors opened on Saturday night due to inclement weather. The venue made the tough decision after monitoring weather patterns all afternoon, and even considered adjusting the set time to make the show work. But in the end, safety came first."
[Short music clip]
Host: "Noah Kahan himself took to Instagram to share the news, saying he was exhausted from trying to make it happen, but loved his fans. The good news is that he's still set to perform at Citi Field on Sunday, so fingers crossed the weather cooperates then."
[Music transitions]
Host: "And it wasn't just Noah Kahan who got hit by the weather. Zeds Dead's concert at nearby Forest Hills Stadium was also called off, but this one's been postponed to August 14th. The duo took to social media to explain that the weather was just too much to handle, and they couldn't risk their production or their fans' safety."
[Short music clip]
Host: "So, if you were planning on catching either of these shows, don't worry – refunds are available from the point of purchase. And if you were looking forward to Zeds Dead, you can still catch them on their Journey of a Lifetime Tour, which continues in Cleveland on July 24th."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today, folks. Thanks for tuning in to our podcast. Stay dry out there, and we'll catch you on the next one!"
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
